messages:
Maya (Partnerships): Helix POC kickoff — partner wants a shared co-sell POC next week. Need quick answers: SSO (SAML), KMS/HSM support, staging tenant IP allowlist, and a pilot pricing estimate. Who can own the infra for the first two weeks? cc @Alex

Priya (Sales AE): I can lead the commercial side. Need a rough pilot quote we can give them tomorrow. They expect ~100k tokens/day for a 2-week pilot. Any ballpark for dedicated vs hosted for that volume?

Alex (Solutions Eng): I can take infra/arch. Proposal: Dedicated pool (2x A10s) for predictable perf + automatic fallback to hosted for bursts. With caching + dynamic batching we should be able to hit ~12–18ms per token for chat-like traffic. Cost model: reserved pilot for baseline, usage for overflow. I'll post a quick calc.

Alex (Solutions Eng): ```
# rough calc (very rough):
100000 tokens/day -> ~1.16 tokens/sec average
Peak concurrency matters more: assume 50 concurrent users -> ~40 tps peak
Dedicated 2x A10 pool + batching handles peak; KV/prefix cache cuts cost ~30%
Estimate: reserved pilot (2 GPUs) ~ $X/day + overflow usage at hosted rates -> I'll fill exact numbers offline.
```

Jordan (Partner Eng): Helix will run the partner UI in their VPC. They'll need tenant provisioning + our SAML metadata. What's the exact handoff step to generate tenant creds and set entitlements?

Alex (Solutions Eng): Process: create tenant in console -> upload SAML metadata -> set entitlements (tokens/day, allowed models) -> generate staging API key scoped to tenant. Example create (demo):
```
curl -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/tenants \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <admin-token>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"helix-staging","quota":100000}'
```
We then share SAML metadata and a short-lived key for testing.

Nate (Security): Security note: Helix is asking for HSM-backed KMS and audit logs. We support AWS KMS and Cloud HSM integrations; on-prem HSM is a special case and may need private deployment or VPC + Bring-Your-Own-HSM. I'll send them our security questionnaire and confirm SOC2 + data residency options.

Priya (Sales AE): Can we offer a discounted trial price? They want committed capacity only for the 2-week pilot. If we need a reserved min, we'll need a short MSA addendum. Any quick guidance?

Maya (Partnerships): Owners: Alex — infra/ops, Priya — commercial, Jordan — partner-eng tenant handoff, Nate — security questionnaire. I'll own the runbook/coordination. Target: staging tenant ready by Tue (48h).

Alex (Solutions Eng): Starting tenant create now. Creating helix-staging with baseline entitlements.

deploy-bot: staging tenant helix-staging-2765 created by Alex (Solutions Eng). Console link: https://console.redwood.ai/tenants/t-abc123 :rocket:

Jordan (Partner Eng): Helix asked for IP ranges to allowlist egress. They need 3 IPs for the initial test window — I'll paste their CIDRs in a follow-up message and coordinate the firewall window.

Maya (Partnerships): Nate — please drop the sec questionnaire link and flag any immediate blockers (HSM, data residency). Priya — let's sync after Alex posts the finalized cost calc.

Nate (Security): Security questionnaire: https://docs.redwood.ai/sec/q1. On HSM: short answer is "we have managed KMS options, and HSM-backed keys require private deployment or customer-managed HSM; I'll confirm feasible options and timeline by EOD."
